summary: A mixed legal and retail day led by court rulings on IP enforcement and a key supply agreement. Supreme Court upheld copyright ruling against composer Ilaiyaraaja; Vadilal Industries secured fresh 12-month supply deal amid family dispute.

bullets.text: Supreme Court refuses to interfere with Delhi HC ruling against Ilaiyaraaja over En Iniya Pon Nilave song copyright dispute.
Allahabad High Court mandates CCTV cameras at police stations remain functional 24x7 for continuous monitoring.
Vadilal Industries signs revised 12-month supply agreement with Vadilal Enterprises amid ongoing family dispute.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030, driven by Q2 demand surge.
Reliance plans $1 billion securitization deal as part of borrowing push to strengthen capital structure.
